Closed on national holidays; hours from southandaman.nic.in which lists no Monday hours (treated as closed Monday). Some travel sites claim open all days - confirm locally.

Boats depart roughly 8:30 AM - 2:00/4:00 PM from Aberdeen Jetty / Water Sports Complex; closed Wednesdays per multiple sources. Last return boats around 4-5 PM. Schedules published by ferry operators vary - confirm at the jetty.

No officially published daily hours; island is open during daylight. Ferries depart ~9:00 AM and return ~3:00 PM; water activities run daylight hours. Timings vary by operator and season - confirm at the jetty.
No officially published hours; accessible sunrise to sunset. Water sports generally operate until ~5:00 PM.
Closed Mondays and national holidays; lunch break 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM per some sources.
Closed Mondays and government holidays. One older source claims Thursday closure - not corroborated by recent sources.
Closed Sundays and public holidays per most sources; one source claims Monday closure - not corroborated. Guided tour Rs 50 extra per published sources.
Closed Mondays and during monsoon months; boats to Jolly Buoy / Red Skin leave Wandoor 8:30-10:30 AM and return by ~2:30 PM. Seasonal: Jolly Buoy Dec-May, Red Skin May-Nov.
Beach is open daylight hours (roughly sunrise to sunset); no officially published hours. Biological Park ~9 AM-4 PM with Monday closure reported but not firmly published - confirm locally.
Closed Mondays, second Saturdays and public holidays. One source claims Wednesday closure instead - not corroborated by recent sources.
No officially published hours; shops generally open through the day, typically ~9:00 AM - 9:00 PM. Not a published figure so left null.
Open 9 AM-7 PM except Mondays per andamanescapes/andamanemeraldholidays; some sources claim open daily 9 AM-8:30 PM - conflict noted, confirm locally.

Complex open 6 AM-10 PM daily per andamantourism.org.in; activity counters generally 10 AM-5/6:30 PM. Activity prices (jet ski Rs 550, sea walk Rs 3200, scuba Rs 3500) from published lists - vary by operator.
Open public site; no officially published hours.
Triphobo lists 5:30 AM - 8:00 PM; other sources describe it as open throughout the day. Pets not allowed per traveltriangle.
Open outdoor site; no officially published hours or entry fee.
No gate hours published; accessible during daylight. Ferry fare Rs 75/person per andamanbeacon; other sources cite Rs 75-300 - vary by operator. Boat departs ~9 AM from Aberdeen Jetty area.
Timings 7 AM-5 PM widely published; last entry often mid-afternoon. Entry Rs 25 Indians / Rs 250-500 foreigners (sources conflict on foreigner fee); camera fees separate.

No published gate hours; the trip is convoy-driven. Convoy gates at Jirkatang commonly 6 AM / 9 AM / 12 PM / 3 PM. Day tours ~Rs 1,500-2,500/person all-in; private cab ~Rs 4,500-6,000 - operator prices, vary.
Open seven days 9 AM-7 PM per Outlook Traveller; ticketed entry (price not published - left null).
Hours 10:30 AM-10:30 PM daily from listings; mixed reviews on service - set expectations accordingly.
Rooftop bar/lounge; evening-dinner focus but no firmly published daily hours found - left null rather than assumed.
Hours 7 AM-10 PM daily widely published; one source claims 7:30 AM-11:30 PM - conflict noted.
Hours from listing aggregators; a similarly named 'Bengali Hotel' lists 8 AM-9 PM - possible confusion between listings, confirm locally.
No firmly published daily hours found - left null.
Hours 11:30 AM-10:00 PM daily from listings. Own site seafoodandaman.com exists but was not fetched to verify - left null.
No fixed timings; access depends entirely on the day's low-tide window. Go early morning or late afternoon within the low-tide period.
Hours as listed on TripAdvisor; confirm locally as they may change by season.
